data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'awwaza, meaning 'to protect' or 'to guard.' This name is often used for those who are seen as protectors and guardians, both in a literal and spiritual sense. The name Muawwazah carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muawwazah usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
